slots.notes: Inline product-demo video sitting below the CTA (mt-12, max-w-5xl, rounded-xl overflow-hidden, no drop shadow); muted autoPlay loop playsInline. Shows the Terra map product itself, not a fullscreen background.

Single UI typeface applied globally; drives the logo wordmark, all nav links + buttons, the Product Hunt badge, the two-line display headline, the subtext and the CTA label. Spec declares Inter (Google Fonts, weights 400/500/700).

mechanic: A static (non-scrolling) min-h-screen nav + centered flex-column hero whose signature device is a hand-drawn dotted 'selection box' SVG framing the gradient-clipped word 'builder', with a muted autoplay-looping product video below; motion is limited to the looping video and nav hover/foreground transitions.
techDelivery: Single-file React component spec on Tailwind CSS utility classes (mobile-first lg: breakpoint), lucide-react for the Menu/X hamburger icons and dropdown chevrons, hand-authored inline-styled SVG for the dotted selection box (viewBox 0 0 200 95, preserveAspectRatio="none", inline rotate(-0.5deg)) and an inline linear-gradient + bg-clip-text/text-transparent treatment for the 'builder' word; Inter loaded from Google Fonts (weights 400/500/700).
reskinNotes: The dotted selection-box SVG is fully hardcoded: the #B0B0B0 stroke/dot fills, the strokeDasharray 6 4, the irregular-quadrilateral path (M5 5 L195 5 L195 88 L5 72 Z, deliberately asymmetric so the bottom-right corner drops lower) and the 8 corner/midpoint circle coordinates are all baked into markup, so retinting or resizing the frame means editing the SVG, not swapping a token. The 'builder' gradient (#767676 -> #D3D3D3, 135deg) is an inline background-image, and the Product Hunt badge bakes in Tailwind red-200/red-50/red-400/red-500 utility colors that ignore the brand palette. The headline uses a hardcoded inline letter-spacing:-0.2em plus per-line/per-word color spans (primary line 1, primary 'map' + gradient 'builder'), so layout is tuned to Inter metrics and the line break is hardcoded. Background/foreground/muted/border read from Tailwind semantic tokens (bg-background, foreground, muted-foreground, primary-foreground) whose hex is not declared in the spec (values recorded here are the conventional Tailwind defaults); only the primary blue #2E7DF3 and the SVG/gradient greys are literal. All nav labels, badge text, headline, subtext, CTA labels and the 🌍/🏆 emojis are hardcoded in the JSX; the logo is a CSS gradient circle (from-primary to-blue-400) wrapping the globe emoji rather than a fillable image asset.
